indicator_name: Kazakhstan exports by partner, thousand USD (WITS TradeStats, UN Comtrade)
description: Экспорт Казахстана по странам-партнёрам (WITS/UN Comtrade), тыс. долларов США
methodology: 1995 onward, as reported by Kazakhstan to UN Comtrade. Matches BNS for EAEU partners; understates non-EAEU flows in 2020-2022 -- prefer KZ_EXPORTS_BY_PARTNER from 2020. Legacy partner codes ROM/SER/ZAR/SUD/MNT/TMP mapped to ISO3; regional aggregates dropped.
